purpose: Eliminate moving-main stale-on-arrival currentness as a training-admission failure class without requiring a research artifact to guess which numbered ledger will still be current when its commit lands.
preserves_from_predecessors: scientifically useful donor content may coexist with stale lifecycle metadata
commit timestamp and filename recency do not establish training authority
stale-on-arrival currentness forces donor-only status until explicit successor reentry
no positive-row generation while provenance/execution gates remain open
admission_algorithm: Given candidate artifact commit C, walk admitted first-parent/full ancestry according to the repository's declared authority rule and enumerate Trigger-2 training ledgers reachable from C's parent.
Resolve the newest reachable admitted ledger L by explicit supersedes edges plus ancestry, not timestamp alone.
Resolve newest owner/supervisor authority A independently; fail closed if authority ordering is ambiguous.
Compare candidate-declared predecessor/current ledger and authority metadata with L and A.

If candidate declares an older ledger/authority than was already reachable from its parent and does not explicitly classify itself as donor/reentry-on-older-snapshot, mark STALE_ON_ARRIVAL_CURRENTNESS and force DONOR_ONLY_NEEDS_REENTRY.
If candidate is scientifically nonconflicting but metadata-stale, preserve content/provenance and revision reason; never silently discard or silently promote it.
If candidate conflicts with newer authority, classify SUPERSEDED_OR_REJECTED according to the exact conflict; do not average versions.
Before dataset admission, require that every transitive training source has a resolved lifecycle state and no unresolved stale-on-arrival authority/currentness edge.
After a concurrent write, re-run ancestry resolution; a successful write does not freeze the frontier.
